resources.string: Type — keys go to the focused app
VSpace uses Shizuku to place apps on the glasses’ virtual screens. The Play Store build is not offered on Android 16 — install the latest APK from Shizuku’s GitHub releases (free, open-source).
Shizuku is installed but not started. Open it and start the service via Wireless debugging — it runs on-device, no PC needed.
Shizuku is running. Grant VSpace access to continue.
Glasses connected — tap apps to add screens (up to 3).
Connect your VITURE glasses to open the workspace.
Finish Shizuku setup first — see the banner above.
